paragraphs: Rav Naḥman bar Shemuel bar Naḥman, Jerusalem Talmud, Megillah 1, end of halakhah 1. Before R. Ammi, Jerusalem Talmud, Bava Batra 9:4:2 [Heilprin cites halakhah 6]. R. Tanḥuma in his name, Midrash Kohelet at 'There is nothing good for man that he eat.' Tanḥuma, Noaḥ, has R. Naḥman bar Shemuel bar Naḥmani; likewise Jerusalem Talmud, Shabbat 1, halakhah 4, in R. Shemuel bar Naḥmani's name. Midrash Kohelet, 'He made everything beautiful in its time': R. Neḥemyah bar Shemuel bar Naḥman.
